verdict.rationale: Sierra explicitly ties agents to live backend systems via its MCP gateway ('safely connects AI agents to the tools and systems that power our company') and its voice agent 'leverages memory for personalized experiences and delivers accurate, real-time resolutions,' while Live Assist 'automatically captures and updates customer context.' Independent community commentary corroborates that Sierra deployments are built to work with a customer's internal APIs rather than static help content. missing for 10: a concrete named example of live order-status/account-history lookup, and independent benchmarking of live-data accuracy versus canned answers.
